description_html:
This one bedroom Barbican apartment (Type 71) has the advantage of a south-facing balcony, reception room and bedroom. As such, the flat is flooded with natural light, morning to evening. A bespoke, full refurbishment by Barbican interior specialists Thomson Brothers, has sympathetically modernised the space.

The kitchen has contemporary integrated appliances, counter tops and cabinets, with space for a breakfast bar area. The bedroom is larger than average with fitted wardrobes.

There is a large shower room with double sinks and a separate study with fitted wardrobes, able to serve as a guest bedroom.

The apartment also offers built in, floor-to-ceiling bookcases and wood floors. Extended lease.

Residents enjoy full access to the private gardens and lakes. Underground parking and storage can be directly rented from the City of London Corporation by separate negotiation.

Included within the service charge is background heating, refuse collection from your door, garden maintenance, window cleaning and building insurance.

Gilbert House is one of the most popular blocks, situated at the centre of the Barbican Estate, within a few minutes walk of the Barbican Centre, with its concert hall, art galleries, theatres, cinemas, libraries, restaurants and conservatory.

Situated in the centre of the Barbican, you are a short walk from Barbican, Moorgate and Farringdon stations. With access to multiple underground lines, the Elizabeth Line and Thameslink. This provides convenient travel to Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted and Luton Airports.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £5,804 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: E
